goal: Prevent evicting mineable transactions that exceed the age limit, such as parents waiting for fee bumps
Reduce per-entry memory usage and eliminate index maintenance overhead across the mempool
agreement: Unaddressed objection: functional test no longer checks parent resubmission before child (fametrano)
Unaddressed suggestion: document in release notes that abandontransaction behavior changed (fametrano)
Answered objection: removing expiry entirely prevents node operators from reverting if harmful (ajtowns)
Concept approval citing obsolete historical justifications and code cleanup (stickies-v, maflcko, tumutech)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because age eviction is incentive-incompatible and can drop transactions that could still be mined
Reduces memory overhead per transaction and removes insertion and deletion costs from an ordered index
